title: CSS UI QA 100-point review rubric
description: Manual review categories with sample automated checks; a score is not a WCAG audit or a performance metric.

dimensions.criteria: 320px width and 200% zoom without content loss or horizontal page overflow
Keyboard access, visible focus and semantic controls
Light/dark preference and actual readable foreground/background contrast

disclaimer: Record evidence and untested conditions; automated checks cover selected points only.
